verses.textZh: 为基督耶稣被囚禁的保罗，和提摩太弟兄，写信给我们所爱的，又一同作工的腓利门，
verses.textZhCnvs: 为基督耶稣被囚禁的保罗，和提摩太弟兄，写信给我们所爱的，又一同作工的腓利门，
verses.textZhCuv: 为基督耶稣被囚的保罗，同兄弟提摩太写信给我们所亲爱的同工腓利门，
verses.textEnNiv: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our dear friend and fellow worker—
verses.textEnEsv: Paul, a prisoner for Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our beloved fellow worker
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our beloved friend and fellow laborer,
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul, a prisoner for preaching the Good News about Christ Jesus, and from our brother Timothy. I am writing to Philemon, our beloved co-worker,
verses.textEnNasb: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our beloved brother and fellow worker,
verses.textEn: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our dear friend and fellow worker—

verses.textZh: 和亚腓亚姊妹，并我们的战友亚基布，以及在你家里的教会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和亚腓亚姊妹，并我们的战友亚基布，以及在你家里的教会。
verses.textZhCuv: 和妹子亚腓亚并与我们同当兵的亚基布，以及在你家的教会。
verses.textEnNiv: also to Apphia our sister and Archippus our fellow soldier—and to the church that meets in your home:
verses.textEnEsv: and Apphia our sister and Archippus our fellow soldier, and the church in your house:
verses.textEnNkjv: to the beloved Apphia, Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church in your house:
verses.textEnNlt: and to our sister Apphia, and to our fellow soldier Archippus, and to the church that meets in your house.
verses.textEnNasb: and to Apphia our sister, and to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church in your house:
verses.textEn: also to Apphia our sister and Archippus our fellow soldier—and to the church that meets in your home:

verses.textZh: 愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿恩惠、平安从神我们的父和主耶稣基督归与你们！
verses.textEnNiv: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 愿你与众人分享你的信心的时候，会产生功效，使我们可以知道在我们中间的一切善事，都是为基督作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你与众人分享你的信心的时候，会产生功效，使我们可以知道在我们中间的一切善事，都是为基督作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我祷告的时候提到你，常为你感谢我的神；
verses.textEnNiv: I always thank my God as I remember you in my prayers,
verses.textEnEsv: I thank my God always when I remember you in my prayers,
verses.textEnNkjv: I thank my God, making mention of you always in my prayers,
verses.textEnNlt: I always thank my God when I pray for you, Philemon,
verses.textEnNasb: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
verses.textEn: I always thank my God as I remember you in my prayers,

verses.textZh: 弟兄啊，众圣徒的心既然从你得到舒畅，我也因你的爱心，得到更大的喜乐和安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄啊，众圣徒的心既然从你得到舒畅，我也因你的爱心，得到更大的喜乐和安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 因听说你的爱心并你向主耶稣和众圣徒的信心 。
verses.textEnNiv: because I hear about your love for all his holy people and your faith in the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: because I hear of your love and of the faith that you have toward the Lord Jesus and for all the saints,
verses.textEnNkjv: hearing of your love and faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
verses.textEnNlt: because I keep hearing about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all of God’s people.
verses.textEnNasb: because I hear of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints;
verses.textEn: because I hear about your love for all his holy people and your faith in the Lord Jesus.

verses.textZh: 我在基督里虽然可以放胆吩咐你作应作的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在基督里虽然可以放胆吩咐你作应作的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你与人所同有的信心显出功效，使人知道你们各样善事都是为基督做的。
verses.textEnNiv: I pray that your partnership with us in the faith may be effective in deepening your understanding of every good thing we share for the sake of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: and I pray that the sharing of your faith may become effective for the full knowledge of every good thing that is in us for the sake of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the sharing of your faith may become effective by the acknowledgment of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: And I am praying that you will put into action the generosity that comes from your faith as you understand and experience all the good things we have in Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: and I pray that the fellowship of your faith may become effective through the knowledge of every good thing which is in you for the sake of Christ.
verses.textEn: I pray that your partnership with us in the faith may be effective in deepening your understanding of every good thing we share for the sake of Christ.

verses.textZh: 然而像我这上了年纪的保罗，现在又是为基督耶稣被囚禁的，宁愿凭着爱心请求你，
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而像我这上了年纪的保罗，现在又是为基督耶稣被囚禁的，宁愿凭着爱心请求你，
verses.textZhCuv: 兄弟啊，我为你的爱心，大有快乐，大得安慰，因众圣徒的心从你得了畅快。
verses.textEnNiv: Your love has given me great joy and encouragement, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the Lord’s people.
verses.textEnEsv: For I have derived much joy and comfort from your love, my brother, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we have great joy and consolation in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed by you, brother.
verses.textEnNlt: Your love has given me much joy and comfort, my brother, for your kindness has often refreshed the hearts of God’s people.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have had great joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
verses.textEn: Your love has given me great joy and encouragement, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the Lord’s people.

verses.textZh: 就是为我在囚禁时所生的儿子欧尼西慕求你；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是为我在囚禁时所生的儿子欧尼西慕求你；
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽然靠着基督能放胆吩咐你合宜的事，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, although in Christ I could be bold and order you to do what you ought to do,
verses.textEnEsv: Accordingly, though I am bold enough in Christ to command you to do what is required,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, though I might be very bold in Christ to command you what is fitting,
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I am boldly asking a favor of you. I could demand it in the name of Christ because it is the right thing for you to do.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, though I have enough confidence in Christ to order you to do what is proper,
verses.textEn: Therefore, although in Christ I could be bold and order you to do what you ought to do,

verses.textZh: 他从前对你没有甚么好处，但现在对你我都有好处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从前对你没有甚么好处，但现在对你我都有好处。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而像我这有年纪的保罗，现在又是为基督耶稣被囚的，宁可凭着爱心求你，
verses.textEnNiv: yet I prefer to appeal to you on the basis of love. It is as none other than Paul—an old man and now also a prisoner of Christ Jesus—
verses.textEnEsv: yet for love’s sake I prefer to appeal to you—I, Paul, an old man and now a prisoner also for Christ Jesus—
verses.textEnNkjv: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal toyou—being such a one as Paul, the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ—
verses.textEnNlt: But because of our love, I prefer simply to ask you. Consider this as a request from me—Paul, an old man and now also a prisoner for the sake of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you—since I am such a person as Paul, an old man, and now also a prisoner of Christ Jesus—
verses.textEn: yet I prefer to appeal to you on the basis of love. It is as none other than Paul—an old man and now also a prisoner of Christ Jesus—

verses.textZh: 我现在打发他亲自回到你那里去；他是我所心爱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我现在打发他亲自回到你那里去；他是我所心爱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是为我在捆锁中所生的儿子阿尼西谋 求你。
verses.textEnNiv: that I appeal to you for my son Onesimus, who became my son while I was in chains.
verses.textEnEsv: I appeal to you for my child, Onesimus, whose father I became in my imprisonment.
verses.textEnNkjv: I appeal to you for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten while in my chains,
verses.textEnNlt: I appeal to you to show kindness to my child, Onesimus. I became his father in the faith while here in prison.
verses.textEnNasb: I appeal to you for my son Onesimus, whom I fathered in my imprisonment,
verses.textEn: that I appeal to you for my son Onesimus, who became my son while I was in chains.

verses.textZh: 我本来想把他留在我这里，使他在我为福音被囚禁时，可以替你服事我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我本来想把他留在我这里，使他在我为福音被囚禁时，可以替你服事我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从前与你没有益处，但如今与你我都有益处。
verses.textEnNiv: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.
verses.textEnEsv: (Formerly he was useless to you, but now he is indeed useful to you and to me.)
verses.textEnNkjv: who once was unprofitable to you, but now is profitable to you and to me.
verses.textEnNlt: Onesimus hasn’t been of much use to you in the past, but now he is very useful to both of us.
verses.textEnNasb: who previously was useless to you, but now is useful both to you and to me.
verses.textEn: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.

verses.textZh: 但还没有得到你的同意，我就不愿意这样作，好叫你的善行不是出于勉强，而是出于甘心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但还没有得到你的同意，我就不愿意这样作，好叫你的善行不是出于勉强，而是出于甘心。
verses.textZhCuv: 我现在打发他亲自回你那里去；他是我心上的人。
verses.textEnNiv: I am sending him—who is my very heart—back to you.
verses.textEnEsv: I am sending him back to you, sending my very heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am sending him back. You therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
verses.textEnNlt: I am sending him back to you, and with him comes my own heart.
verses.textEnNasb: I have sent him back to you in person, that is, sending my very heart,
verses.textEn: I am sending him—who is my very heart—back to you.

verses.textZh: 也许他暂时离开你，正是为了使你永远得着他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 也许他暂时离开你，正是为了使你永远得着他，
verses.textZhCuv: 我本来有意将他留下，在我为福音所受的捆锁中替你伺候我。
verses.textEnNiv: I would have liked to keep him with me so that he could take your place in helping me while I am in chains for the gospel.
verses.textEnEsv: I would have been glad to keep him with me, in order that he might serve me on your behalf during my imprisonment for the gospel,
verses.textEnNkjv: whom I wished to keep with me, that on your behalf he might minister to me in my chains for the gospel.
verses.textEnNlt: I wanted to keep him here with me while I am in these chains for preaching the Good News, and he would have helped me on your behalf.
verses.textEnNasb: whom I wanted to keep with me, so that in your behalf he might be at my service in my imprisonment for the gospel;
verses.textEn: I would have liked to keep him with me so that he could take your place in helping me while I am in chains for the gospel.

verses.textZh: 不再是奴隶，而是高过奴隶，是亲爱的弟兄。对我固然是这样，对你来说，不论按肉身或在主内的关系，更是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不再是奴隶，而是高过奴隶，是亲爱的弟兄。对我固然是这样，对你来说，不论按肉身或在主内的关系，更是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 但不知道你的意思，我就不愿意这样行，叫你的善行不是出于勉强，乃是出于甘心。
verses.textEnNiv: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that any favor you do would not seem forced but would be voluntary.
verses.textEnEsv: but I preferred to do nothing without your consent in order that your goodness might not be by compulsion but of your own accord.
verses.textEnNkjv: But without your consent I wanted to do nothing, that your good deed might not be by compulsion, as it were, but voluntary.
verses.textEnNlt: But I didn’t want to do anything without your consent. I wanted you to help because you were willing, not because you were forced.
verses.textEnNasb: but I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness would not be, in effect, by compulsion, but of your own free will.
verses.textEn: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that any favor you do would not seem forced but would be voluntary.

verses.textZh: 所以，你要是把我看作同伴，就接纳他好象接纳我一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你要是把我看作同伴，就接纳他好象接纳我一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他暂时离开你，或者是叫你永远得着他，
verses.textEnNiv: Perhaps the reason he was separated from you for a little while was that you might have him back forever—
verses.textEnEsv: For this perhaps is why he was parted from you for a while, that you might have him back forever,
verses.textEnNkjv: For perhaps he departed for a while for this purpose, that you might receive him forever,
verses.textEnNlt: It seems you lost Onesimus for a little while so that you could have him back forever.
verses.textEnNasb: For perhaps it was for this reason that he was separated from you for a while, that you would have him back forever,
verses.textEn: Perhaps the reason he was separated from you for a little while was that you might have him back forever—

verses.textZh: 如果他使你受了损失，或欠你甚么，都记在我的帐上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他使你受了损失，或欠你甚么，都记在我的帐上。
verses.textZhCuv: 不再是奴仆，乃是高过奴仆，是亲爱的兄弟。在我实在是如此，何况在你呢！这也不拘是按肉体说，是按主说。
verses.textEnNiv: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a dear brother. He is very dear to me but even dearer to you, both as a fellow man and as a brother in the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: no longer as a bondservant but more than a bondservant, as a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: no longer as a slave but more than a slave—a beloved brother, especially to me but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He is no longer like a slave to you. He is more than a slave, for he is a beloved brother, especially to me. Now he will mean much more to you, both as a man and as a brother in the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
verses.textEn: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a dear brother. He is very dear to me but even dearer to you, both as a fellow man and as a brother in the Lord.

verses.textZh: "我必偿还"，这是我保罗亲手写的。用不着我说，甚至你的生命，你也是欠我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我必偿还"，这是我保罗亲手写的。用不着我说，甚至你的生命，你也是欠我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若以我为同伴，就收纳他，如同收纳我一样。
verses.textEnNiv: So if you consider me a partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.
verses.textEnEsv: So if you consider me your partner, receive him as you would receive me.
verses.textEnNkjv: If then you count me as a partner, receive him as youwould me.
verses.textEnNlt: So if you consider me your partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.
verses.textEnNasb: If then you regard me as a partner, accept him as you would me.
verses.textEn: So if you consider me a partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.

verses.textZh: 所以弟兄啊！让我在主里得到你的帮助，使我的心在基督里得着畅快。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以弟兄啊！让我在主里得到你的帮助，使我的心在基督里得着畅快。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若亏负你，或欠你什么，都归在我的帐上；
verses.textEnNiv: If he has done you any wrong or owes you anything, charge it to me.
verses.textEnEsv: If he has wronged you at all, or owes you anything, charge that to my account.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if he has wronged you or owes anything, put that on my account.
verses.textEnNlt: If he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to me.
verses.textEnNasb: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge that to my account;
verses.textEn: If he has done you any wrong or owes you anything, charge it to me.

verses.textZh: 我深信你会听从，也知道你所作的必超过我所说的，因此才写信给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我深信你会听从，也知道你所作的必超过我所说的，因此才写信给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必偿还，这是我－保罗亲笔写的。我并不用对你说，连你自己也是亏欠于我。
verses.textEnNiv: I, Paul, am writing this with my own hand. I will pay it back—not to mention that you owe me your very self.
verses.textEnEsv: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it—to say nothing of your owing me even your own self.
verses.textEnNkjv: I, Paul, am writing with my own hand. I will repay—not to mention to you that you owe me even your own self besides.
verses.textEnNlt: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it. And I won’t mention that you owe me your very soul!
verses.textEnNasb: I, Paul, have written this with my own hand, I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self as well).
verses.textEn: I, Paul, am writing this with my own hand. I will pay it back—not to mention that you owe me your very self.

verses.textZh: 同时，还请你为我预备住的地方，因为我盼望借着你们的祷告，可以获得释放到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 同时，还请你为我预备住的地方，因为我盼望借着你们的祷告，可以获得释放到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 兄弟啊，望你使我在主里因你得快乐 ，并望你使我的心在基督里得畅快。
verses.textEnNiv: I do wish, brother, that I may have some benefit from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Yes, brother, I want some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, my brother, please do me this favor for the Lord’s sake. Give me this encouragement in Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Yes, brother, let me benefit from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in Christ.
verses.textEn: I do wish, brother, that I may have some benefit from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in Christ.

verses.textZh: 为基督耶稣的缘故和我一同坐监的以巴弗，
verses.textZhCnvs: 为基督耶稣的缘故和我一同坐监的以巴弗，
verses.textZhCuv: 我写信给你，深信你必顺服，知道你所要行的必过于我所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.
verses.textEnEsv: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I say.
verses.textEnNkjv: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I say.
verses.textEnNlt: I am confident as I write this letter that you will do what I ask and even more!
verses.textEnNasb: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, since I know that you will do even more than what I say.
verses.textEn: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.

verses.textZh: 以及我的同工马可、亚里达古、底马、路加都问候你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及我的同工马可、亚里达古、底马、路加都问候你。
verses.textZhCuv: 此外你还要给我预备住处；因为我盼望藉着你们的祷告，必蒙恩到你们那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: And one thing more: Prepare a guest room for me, because I hope to be restored to you in answer to your prayers.
verses.textEnEsv: At the same time, prepare a guest room for me, for I am hoping that through your prayers I will be graciously given to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But, meanwhile, also prepare a guest room for me, for I trust that through your prayers I shall be granted to you.
verses.textEnNlt: One more thing—please prepare a guest room for me, for I am hoping that God will answer your prayers and let me return to you soon.
verses.textEnNasb: At the same time also prepare me a guest room, for I hope that through your prayers I will be given to you.
verses.textEn: And one thing more: Prepare a guest room for me, because I hope to be restored to you in answer to your prayers.

verses.textZh: 愿主耶稣基督的恩惠常与你们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿主耶稣基督的恩惠常与你们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 为基督耶稣与我同坐监的以巴弗问你安。
verses.textEnNiv: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings.
verses.textEnEsv: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends greetings to you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
verses.textEnNlt: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you his greetings.
verses.textEnNasb: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
verses.textEn: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings.

verses.textZh: 与我同工的马可、亚里达古、底马、路加也都问你安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 与我同工的马可、亚里达古、底马、路加也都问你安。
verses.textZhCuv: 与我同工的马可、亚里达古、底马、路加也都问你安。
verses.textEnNiv: And so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas and Luke, my fellow workers.
verses.textEnEsv: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
